verdict.rationale: Microsoft Copilot is driven by natural-language prompts. The docs cover chat prompting in Word, Excel and PowerPoint, voice prompts in natural language, connectors to find and act on information in linked services, and Browse with Copilot, which performs clicks, typing and navigation in Edge. A hands-on report (copilot-comm-4) says Copilot in Word could not create tables, search and replace, or keep formatting, which limits how much natural-language commands can actually do inside apps. missing for 10: independent corroboration that natural-language commands reliably execute in-app edits, and documentation of which operations can and cannot be commanded.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Prompt Copilot with the task, add and upload notes, then refine in the chat—all with Copilot in Word.
Detail your task, attach data, and tweak via chat.
If users send prompts in natural language voice within the Copilot Voice mode, they will receive audio responses.
Browse with Copilot lets Copilot perform actions directly in your Microsoft Edge browser, such as clicking, typing, and navigating tabs.
Connectors allow you to link Copilot to other services so you can easily find, summarize, and act on information from these services.
